dedupe_keys.name: croatia water services council reports on the water services sector 2015 2021 water prices price components development fees and financial indicators

description: Annual reports of Croatia's Water Services Council (Vijeće za vodne usluge), the body that oversaw the legality of water service prices and development fees and kept the collection of price data, now hosted on the Ministry of Economy's site. Listed on 2026-09-29: reports on the state of the water services sector for 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020 and 2021, a report for March 2015 to December 2016, and a separate study of water prices in Croatia from March 2015 to December 2016. The 2021 report (about 80 pages) covers the institutional framework, the structure of the water price (fixed and variable parts of the service price, development fee, water use and water protection charges, VAT), prices of water supply and drainage services, charges for emptying individual (mobile) drainage systems, the development fee, financial indicators of the water services sector, administrative disputes and trends. Coverage: national, Croatia, with prices by water service provider. Format and access: PDF reports in Croatian, free. Licence: not stated. Caveats: 2021 is the latest report listed, so the series looks discontinued; the council's own domain no longer resolves; tables must be transcribed from PDF. Simulation uses: affordability and capacity planning for drinking water and wastewater services. Related records: compare with Italy's ARERA water service quality data by operator (data-arera-water-service-contractual-quality-by-operator-italy).
